invariants.presentationTimestamp: required and strictly increasing within one generation
invariants.timeBase: positive and constant within one generation
invariants.capacity: refuse before adaptation when either frame or byte budget would be exceeded
invariants.cancellation: operation cancellation rejects one enqueue; generation cancellation clears the queue and rejects every late frame
invariants.staleResult: a result for any non-current generation or changed revision never mutates the buffer
invariants.dequeue: frames leave in accepted presentation order
